_status: DOCUMENTATION OF A SHAPE — no validator reads this file. Nothing in this engine imports jsonschema; the invariants are enforced in code by classification.validate_header, classification._raw_field_findings, docgen.identity.header_findings, doc_manifest and export_sanitizer. A retained counter-example (tools/tests/test_doc_identity.py) asserts this file and models.DocHeader declare the same field names, so the two cannot drift apart silently. Labelled here 2026-08-22 because OG-39 closed NOT_A_DEFECT on the reasoning that these files were 'labelled as such at their point of use', and they were not (OG-91).
title: DocHeader
description: The required document metadata header (RULEBOOK L5; CLASSIFICATION.md). Mirrors tools/docgen/models.py DocHeader.

id.description: <PREFIX>-<NNN>; PREFIX must be a known TAXONOMY.md doc-type prefix.

version.description: Archived generation. 0 = never cut into docs/archive/<id>/vN/. Bumped by `docgen archive cut`.

revision.description: Edits made since the current version was cut. 0 claims the live bytes still equal the archived snapshot — a claim tools.docgen.archive.freeze_state re-derives from the bytes rather than believing. Illegal while version is 0.

produced_by.description: Engine or agent attribution for this document's content. Author-declared; never filled in automatically, because a tool that writes its own attribution is manufacturing the evidence.

verified_state.description: Whether this document CLAIMS verification at its current revision. 'verified' requires a content-certifying stamp whose commit still covers the body; the claim is refutable and is refuted. 'superseded' is deliberately absent — it is derived from the archive (RULES.md Rule 2), never stated.
